package.name: whill_localization
package.description: Localization bringup for the WHILL chair. Provides the M4-R odom-layer EKF (`robot_localization`) that fuses wheel odometry and IMU into the `odom -> base_link` TF and `/odometry/filtered` topic, plus the legacy FAST-LIO config retained for offline map-making (M5-R). Online use of FAST-LIO as a runtime localizer is frozen per the platform-pivot plan.
